mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mock_scenario_template (template_id, profile_name, description, definition_json) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{profileName}, #{description}, #{definitionJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE profile_name = #{profileName}, description = #{description}, definition_json = #{definitionJson}
